blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
This paper investigates AutoResearch, a protocol in which a coding language
model edits a training program under a one-hour GPU budget and retains a change
only if validation IoU improves.
The protocol is applied to photovoltaic panel segmentation on a frozen
real-image split, with DeepLabV3–ResNet-50 held fixed.
Three campaigns of 24 experiments, using Gemma 4 12B, Qwen3-8B all improve their one-hour baselines, but retained modifications do
not transfer across hardware.
The Qwen3-8B configuration, trained on real images only, reaches a test IoU of
0.836 versus 0.833 for the reference GAN-augmented schedule. Research repository https://github.com/VU-AIML/automl4eo-autoresearch-segmentation .

协议适用于被冻结的光伏面板分解
real-image split,其中DeepLabV3–ResNet-50被固定.

不通过硬件传输。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Earth observation (EO) segmentation is experimentally sensitive.
Loss functions, learning-rate schedules, optimizers, and augmentations interact
with class imbalance, ground sampling distance (GSD), and the available GPU
memory. Loss function varies from vision-language models Komurcu and Petkevicius (2025) to recent I-JEPA approaches Kömürcü and Petkevicius (2026) .
Published training configurations are often sized for a hardware platform and
epoch budget that differ from those available in a later study.
As a result, transferring a reported configuration is not always effective, and
manual search of the design space is time-consuming.
blocks.zh:
地球观测(EO)分化具有实验敏感性.
损失函数、学习率时间表、优化器和增强器相互作用
和可用的GPU
记忆。 失能功能从视觉语言模型Komurcu和Petkevicius(2025年)到最近的I-JEPA方法Kömürcü和Petkevicius(2026年)不等.
已公布的培训配置通常为硬件平台大小,
与后期研究中的预算不同的划时代预算。
因此,转移报告配置并非总是有效的,而且
人工搜索设计空间很费时。

blocks.en:
AutoResearch ( Karpathy, 2025 ) is not a new segmentation
architecture.
It is a constrained autonomous experiment loop: a coding agent may edit only
the training program, runs a trial under a fixed wall-clock budget, retains the
change if a scalar validation metric improves, and otherwise reverts. This approach is the continuation of the field, as automated approaches were tried in Yamada et al. (2025) ; Becktepe et al. (2025) ; Wąsala et al. (2025) ; Opdam (2025) .
The original implementation of autoresearch targets single-GPU language-model pretraining, with
a budget of about 300 s per idea and validation bits-per-byte as the
acceptance criterion.
We argue that the same control protocol is a natural AutoML operator for EO
segmentation, provided that the data split and the evaluator remain outside the
agent’s control. At each step the coding model sees the current training program, the parseable run footer, and a short instruction file that states the IoU keep/revert rule and the frozen files; it then proposes a free-form code edit rather than a point in a pre-declared search space.
blocks.zh:
自动研究( Karopathy, 2025) 不是一个新的分割
结构。
这是一个受限的自主实验循环:一个编码代理只能编辑
以固定的时钟预算进行审判
如果一个平面校验度量得到改进,则更改,否则将恢复。 这种方法是外地的延续,因为自动化方法在Yamada等人(2025年)、Becktepe等人(2025年)、Wásala等人(2025年)、Opdam(2025年)中进行了试验。
最初实施自动研究的目标为单GPU语言模型预训,
预算大约为300 s ,每个想法和验证比特作为字节
接受标准。
我们主张同样的控制协议是EO的自然自动ML操作器
如果数据分开,评估人员不在
代理人的控制。 每一步编码模型都会看到当前训练程序,可解析跑步脚,以及一个短指令文件,说明IoU保存/倒置规则和被冻结的文件;然后它会提出自由格式代码编辑,而不是在预先宣布的搜索空间中的一个点.

blocks.en:
The experimental testbed is the photovoltaic (PV) panel segmentation setting of Lekavičius and Gružauskas (2024) : DeepLabV3 ( Chen et al., 2017 ) with a ResNet-50
backbone ( He et al., 2016 ) , images resampled to 0.1 0.1 m/pixel and 512 × 512 512\times 512 , and a 2048/256/256 split of real images.
That work improved test intersection-over-union (IoU) from 0.801 without
augmentation to 0.833 by adding 1228 pix2pix ( Isola et al., 2017 ) images and
training for up to 100 epochs on an A100 GPU.
In the present study the architecture and split are frozen, the synthetic
images are withheld, and AutoResearch searches only the training program under
a one-hour budget.

骨干(He等,2016年),图像再被复制到0.1 m/像素和512 × 512 512\times 512,以及2048/256/256分出真实图像.
这项工作改进了试验交叉结合(IoU),从0.801提高到了无。

blocks.en:
The contributions of this paper are threefold.
First, the AutoResearch protocol is ported from language-model pretraining to
binary PV segmentation, with an immutable evaluator and a fixed real-image
split.
Second, three independent 24-experiment campaigns are reported on two GPU
classes, and the retained modifications are compared.
Third, the best Qwen3-8B configuration is evaluated once on the held-out test
split and placed next to the reference Table 5 numbers of Lekavičius and Gružauskas (2024) .
blocks.zh:
本文件的贡献有三重。
首先,自动研究协议从语言模型预训移植到
二进制光电分解,有不可改变的评价器和固定真实图像
分页。
第二,据报告,开展了三次独立24次试验活动,涉及两个全球免疫单位
分类,并比较保留的修改。
第三,最佳的Qwen3-8B配置在被搁置测试中评估一次
将Lekavičius和Gružauskas(2024年)的编号分为两部分,放在参考表5旁边。

blocks.en:
The remainder of the paper is structured as follows.
Section 2 describes the protocol.
Section 3 reports the experimental study.
Section 4 concludes.

第2节描述了协议。
第3节报告实验研究。
第4节结束。

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en:
The preparation program owns the canonical real split, GSD resampling,
object-centric 512 × 512 512\times 512 crops, ImageNet normalization, and the evaluation
function (mean per-image IoU on the 256-image validation set).
The F1 score is logged but is not the acceptance metric.
The agent never trains on validation or test images and cannot edit the
evaluator.
Training is launched only through a wrapper that unloads the coding model,
enforces the wall-clock budget, and prints a parseable footer.

以对象为中心的 512 × 512 512\times 512 个收成,图像 净正常化和评价
函数(256-图像验证集上的平均值为IoU)。
F1分被记录下来,但不是接受度量.
代理从不在验证或测试图像上训练,也不能编辑
评估者。
训练只能通过一个卸下编码模型的包装器启动,
执行时钟预算,并打印一个可解析页脚。

The architecture remains DeepLabV3–ResNet-50.

Each campaign is capped at 24 logged experiments, including the baseline.

blocks.en: 3 Experimental study
blocks.zh: 3 实验研究

blocks.en:
The data follow the reference paper: 640 image–mask pairs from each of four
GSDs (PV08 0.8 m, PV03 0.3 m, IGN 0.2 m, PV01+Google 0.1 m) ( Jiang et al., 2021 ; Kasmi et al., 2023 ) , split 512/64/64 per GSD, with random seed 35.
Only real images are used; the 1228 pix2pix extras are never loaded.
Three independent campaigns are run on this split (Table 1 ).

Table 2 compares overlapping families of modifications.
Changes retained in Loop B are often rejected in Loops A and C, or are not
proposed.
Dice is the only large, repeated retention on GX10-class hardware; it
decreases IoU on the 4070 baseline.
Cosine decay is the only large retention under 12 GB and is rejected in both
GX10 campaigns.
Horizontal flipping, color jitter, and a lower peak learning rate change sign
depending on the configuration on which they are stacked.
Rotation, encoder freezing, and exponential moving averages of the weights are
rejected in every campaign that tries them.
The two GX10 campaigns reach the same validation IoU of 0.858 with different
retained sequences.
This coincidence is consistent with a one-hour performance plateau on this
backbone and split, rather than with a unique AutoML default.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en:
Motivated by the cost of manually searching EO segmentation configurations, this
paper investigates AutoResearch as an AutoML operator for solar-panel
segmentation.
Three campaigns improve one-hour DeepLabV3 baselines on a frozen real split.
The retained modifications are a cosine schedule with reduced weight decay under
12 GB, and two GX10 sequences that both reach a validation IoU of 0.858.
The Qwen3-8B configuration matches the reference test IoU without synthetic
images.
The protocol is effective under a declared budget if the evaluator remains frozen
and retained modifications are not treated as universal defaults.
A direct comparison with a declared-space tuner, and a less restricted loop that may edit architecture, preprocessing, or literature-derived ideas, are left to future work.
blocks.zh:
以人工搜索EO分区配置的成本为动机,
纸质调查 自动研究 as autoML 运算符用于日光板
分会.

保留修改是减低了重量的余弦表
12 GB,和两个GX10序列,两个序列都达到了0.858.
Qwen3-8B 配置匹配不合成的参考测试 IoU
图像。
如果评估人员仍被冻结,协议在已宣布的预算下有效
和保留的修改不作为普遍缺省处理。
与所声明的空间调谐器进行直接比较,以及可以编辑架构,预处理,或由文献衍生出的想法的限制性较弱的循环,都留给了未来工作.
